## About Smart Banking AI by BCG X

When it comes to being customer centric, banks have an advantage: a trove of data, everything from transaction histories, product usage, and risk profiles to online searches and campaign responsiveness. But they also have disadvantages: legacy technology, data scattered across the organization, silos instead of synergies. This makes it hard to create a comprehensive customer view—let alone to leverage AI in banking solutions.

Smart Banking AI from [BCG X](https://www.bcg.com/x/) addresses these challenges head-on, making it simpler to bring data into a single platform, apply the latest technology for AI in financial services, and reach out to the right customer with the right action, when and where it matters.

![](https://web-assets.bcg.com/dims4/default/7b9d267/2147483647/strip/true/crop/1400x788+0+0/resize/500x281!/format/webp/quality/90/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fboston-consulting-group-brightspot.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fc0%2Ff4%2F3424aa0b41a5804fc3ed90ad92aa%2Fsmart-banking-ai-by-bcg-x-video-still.jpg) 

Introducing Smart Banking AI by BCG X

BCG’s analytics-based software solution – SmartBanking AI - delivers pivotal customer insights, empowers relationship managers with high-value leads, and redefines the customer experience, allowing banks to convert their data into customer value.

## How Smart Banking AI Works

 

Generative AI

![](https://web-assets.bcg.com/dims4/default/aecd5d4/2147483647/strip/true/crop/3840x2400+0+0/resize/1920x1200!/format/webp/quality/90/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fboston-consulting-group-brightspot.s3.amazonaws.com%2F23%2F39%2F14a42c2f4e348fb2025810f97482%2Fgenerative-ai-smart-banking-ai.jpg)

### Generative AI

Smart Banking AI employs generative AI to draft hyper-personalized emails, create summaries of key reports, produce investment memos, and identify high-potential clients.

Next Best Solution

![](https://web-assets.bcg.com/dims4/default/0c413d3/2147483647/strip/true/crop/3840x2400+0+0/resize/1920x1200!/format/webp/quality/90/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fboston-consulting-group-brightspot.s3.amazonaws.com%2Ff7%2Fb6%2F6c34d4834b20b4e91334c4ac5c60%2Fnext-best-solution-smart-banking-ai.jpg)

### Next Best Solution

Through machine learning models, Smart Banking AI reveals customers’ needs—and how they may be changing, suggesting products likely to resonate.

Retention

![](https://web-assets.bcg.com/dims4/default/107766d/2147483647/strip/true/crop/3840x2400+0+0/resize/1920x1200!/format/webp/quality/90/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fboston-consulting-group-brightspot.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fdd%2F9a%2F84ad25844246ad52ccd33d06c0e7%2Fretention-smart-banking-ai.jpg)

### Retention

By spotting warning signs of churn, such as a drop-off in transactions, Smart Banking AI can identify at-risk clients and spur proactive engagement to retain business.

Analytical Risk Monitoring

![](https://web-assets.bcg.com/dims4/default/81f2d74/2147483647/strip/true/crop/3840x2400+0+0/resize/1920x1200!/format/webp/quality/90/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fboston-consulting-group-brightspot.s3.amazonaws.com%2F78%2F38%2F9ed49776448ba3766c2446985a5c%2Fanalytical-risk-monitoring-smart-banking-ai.jpg)

### Analytical Risk Monitoring

Smart Banking AI leverages analytics to assign customers to one of three review lanes (in-depth, moderate, or light), reducing credit review costs by up to 30%.

Executive Dashboard

![](https://web-assets.bcg.com/dims4/default/98ec229/2147483647/strip/true/crop/3840x2400+0+0/resize/1920x1200!/format/webp/quality/90/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fboston-consulting-group-brightspot.s3.amazonaws.com%2F51%2F1f%2Fcea4ab6e48f4b985090f32db06a1%2Fexecutive-dashboard-smart-banking-ai.jpg)

### Executive Dashboard

A mission control for relationship managers, Smart Banking AI’s dashboard provides an overview of customer leads and alerts, which can be filtered by region and product.
